## The study

Al Mohajer M, Panthagani KM, Lasco T, Lembcke B, Hemmige V. Association between universal face shield in a quaternary care center and reduction of SARS-COV2 infections among healthcare personnel and hospitalized patients. *International Journal of Infectious Diseases*. 2021;105:252–255 [@almohajer2021faceshield].

Vagish Hemmige performed the statistical analysis and maintains this repository. Scientific decisions for this repository are made by Vagish Hemmige.

## This repository

This repository rebuilds the published analysis from a single R Markdown file into labelled scripts run in order by `R/main.R`, as a teaching resource. The weekly surveillance data are institutional data and are not in the repository; the code finds them through the `COVID_IC_DATA_DIR` setting on the computer of an authorized analyst.

Contributions follow the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](agents.qmd); open decisions and known issues are tracked in [Issues](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/COVID-infection-control/issues).

## How this website was created

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) from the analysis scripts themselves. Each code page imports the labelled sections of its script from `R/` and shows them with an explanation; the site never runs the analysis, so it is built without the study data.

The repository was set up with the R Analysis Workflow plugin for AI coding assistants, written by Vagish Hemmige, following the layout of [Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS); the architecture document is generated with Posit's describe-design skill. An AI assistant (Claude) drafted code and documentation under the rules in `AGENTS.md`: it works only with code and documentation, never with the study data, and every change was reviewed and approved by Vagish Hemmige before it was committed.

Four documents describe the project:

-   [**Analysis plan**](analysis-plan.qmd): *what the analysis does, and why.* The published methods, following SQUIRE 2.0.
-   [**Architecture**](architecture.qmd): *how the code does it.* The scripts, the order they run in, what each needs and produces, and how data flow between them.
-   [**AGENTS.md**](agents.qmd): *how people and AI assistants work on the project.*
-   [**Repository blueprint**](repository-blueprint.qmd): *the layout every project of this kind starts from.*
